name: Loud Badger 55
author: suda-code
description: Neon rounded cyan button that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #2ba8fb to #6fc5ff, box-shadow becomes 0 0 20px #6fc5ff50, transform becomes scale(1.1).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Loud Badger 55</title>
<style>
/* Loud Badger 55 by suda-code — https://uiverse.io/suda-code/loud-badger-55 */
button {
  padding: 12.5px 30px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 100px;
  background-color: #2ba8fb;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: Bold;
  transition: all 0.5s;
  -webkit-transition: all 0.5s;
}

button:hover {
  background-color: #6fc5ff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px #6fc5ff50;
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

button:active {
  background-color: #3d94cf;
  transition: all 0.25s;
  -webkit-transition: all 0.25s;
  box-shadow: none;
  transform: scale(0.98);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
